existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: `HealthcareService` has high-impact local breaking changes: contact details moved from direct `telecom` to `contact`, availability moved into the `Availability` datatype, and `communication` now has a required language binding. The main uncertainty is terminology expansion/enforcement for language codes and real-world mapping policy for availability exceptions.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migrations should prioritize structural transforms before terminology cleanup. Direct R4 contact and availability properties must be rewritten into nested R6 datatypes. R4 communication codings should be audited for BCP-47 compliance. Down-conversion from R6 to R4 needs explicit policy for R6-only elements such as `offeredIn`, `referralRequired`, `eligibility.value[x]`, `eligibility.period`, and `Availability.period`.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for computable StructureDefinition changes because both assigned StructureDefinitions and relevant dependency definitions are present locally. Confidence is lower for terminology edge cases and design rationale because no official diff, ballot change notes, rendered narrative pages, or live terminology expansions were used.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
HealthcareService keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 3 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 1 potential hard break(s), 4 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 0 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 2, which creates neutral stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 53/100, producing migration shape `moderate-targeted-remodel`, major migration `Partial`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

4 finding(s) identify a yes/partial less-breaking base-design alternative, so the aggregate should not be used to dismiss local avoidability review.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: Availability details moved from three direct HealthcareService elements into the R6 Availability datatype
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid plus runtime/API/codegen and R6-to-R4 loss: old direct availability elements are invalid in R6, code must move to the nested datatype, and some R6 availability details or R4 exception text need policy when round-tripping.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Direct `HealthcareService.telecom` was replaced by nested `HealthcareService.contact` using ExtendedContactDetail
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid plus runtime/API/codegen and R6-to-R4 loss: old `telecom` is not a valid R6 element, generated models change from bare `ContactPoint` to `ExtendedContactDetail`, and down-conversion can lose R6-only contact context.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: `HealthcareService.communication` binding strengthened from preferred languages to required all-languages
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid terminology validation plus runtime/API/codegen: R4 local-only `communication` codings tolerated under a preferred binding can fail R6 required-binding validation, and validators or terminology-backed generated code must enforce BCP-47 language tags.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: `HealthcareService.comment` primitive type changed from string to markdown
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: runtime/API/codegen with semantic/documentation effects: the wire value is still a string, but generated primitives, markdown validation/sanitization, and UI rendering can change for existing plain-text comments.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Eligibility gained R6-only value and period fields plus a code-required invariant
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss only: R6 value and period details have no native R4 field, but there is no old-valid/new-invalid R4-to-R6 mechanism for existing eligibility content.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss only: R6 can express a computable referral-required boolean that core R4 lacks, but existing R4 instances do not become invalid in R6.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
